completed.name: conditions
checks: Existing conditional rule appears in the editor and draws in the native grid canvas.

completed.name: ocr
checks: PDF zoom changed the decoded raster from 816 to 1632 pixels at DPR 1.
A blocked-external-network browser recognized both scan-only pages using the bundled Chinese and English models.
The mixed page preserved its real header and the rotated crop retained upright Chinese and English line boxes.
OCR text was selected with the pointer, copied to the clipboard, corrected inline, saved, reloaded and searched.
The source-backed PDF was downloaded, uploaded as a fresh file, and searched by its native invisible OCR layer.

native.evidence: browser OCR measurements replayed through the native CLI
native.pixelComparator: Poppler at 96 DPI, same CropBox, zero differing pixels
